title: autopilot
description: The flight controller's own protection took control, or a person handed control back to the Asset app; in_control says which. On a takeover the Asset cancelled ordinary work and any running response and entered failsafe state, though no Atlas rule started the maneuver, and it refuses operator requests until control is handed back. On a hand-back the Asset holds where it is with every rule re-armed, still in failsafe state. explanation says what the Asset observed.
